entry.name: rnbo_svf~
entry.description: The svf~ object is an implementation of a state-variable filter algorithm described in Hal Chamberlin's book, "Musical Applications of Microprocessors." A unique feature of this filter object is that it produces lowpass, highpass, bandpass, and bandreject (notch) output simultaneously - all four are available as outlets.

arguments.name: freq
arguments.description: Sets the center frequency for the filter.

arguments.name: q
arguments.description: Sets the Q value for the filter. Thefilter takes Q values in the range of 0. through 1.
